description: After the agent writes/edits a file, runs the formatter the project CONFIGURES on just that file (biome for JS/TS/JSON/CSS when a biome config exists and does not plainly switch its formatter off, else oxfmt/prettier when configured; ruff when configured, else black for py; gofmt for go; rustfmt for rs; repo-local tool preferred over global). No-op when no formatter is configured, or the configured one is not installed (never falls through to another). Makes formatting a harness concern instead of a per-project manual step. on_error=open and never blocks: a formatting convenience must never wedge the agent. Escape hatch: NO_FORMAT_HOOK=1.
